noticeFileAbsences.handling: Original crate authors/license declarations and source headers retained. Exact upstream repo license files supplied when available. MIT text from OSI and MPL-2.0 text from Mozilla supplied where release/repository has no standalone license; no copyright notice invented.

rust.policy: Entire unmodified release Cargo.lock superset, including optional/dev/other-target crates. POSIX cargo update --workspace removes disabled GIF/WebP features; MXE patch records the exact lockfile pruning. No dependency upgrade or native build performed.

closure.scope: sharp 0.35.5 / sharp-libvips 1.3.4 native-library sources and Electron 45.0.0 bundled FFmpeg; not the separate CLI FFmpeg 9
closure.toolchains: Compiler/SDK/rust standard-library build tools are referenced by the preserved upstream recipes, not packaged or verified as a reproducible toolchain.

provenance: Primary upstream archive bytes fetched and SHA-256 measured; npm binary metadata authenticated against package-lock SHA-512 integrity; Rust crates checked against release Cargo.lock; Windows native source archive hashes checked against MXE recipe checksums. No binary rebuild performed.
